::: {.personal-profile}
# Personal Profile

I am a Ph.D. student at Tsinghua University. My research interests lie in understanding machine learning models and neural networks.
Starting from observed phenomena, I analyze the root causes of model behavior and aim to develop practical learning methods that are efficient and generalizable.
Recently, I have focused on context compression for DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) architectures and on training stability.
You can read my [personal blog](blog/index.qmd).
